title: A2UI Spectra Conformance Test Suite Schema
description: JSON schema validating the conformance test suites under conformance/.

ValidateTurnRecordTest.description: Validates one turn record fixture against the turn record schema of the suite's version.

name.description: Unique name of the test case.

description.description: What the test verifies. For a case that must fail, the reason it fails.

fixture.description: Path of the turn record fixture, relative to conformance/.

expectError.description: Present when the fixture must fail validation.

CaptureA2aTest.description: Replays one HAR recording of A2A traffic through the A2A capture path and compares the turns it captures with an expected turn record.

name.description: Unique name of the test case.

description.description: The roster entry and the axis values the recording verifies.

traffic.description: Path of the HAR 1.2 recording, relative to conformance/.

expect.description: Path of the expected turn record, relative to conformance/.

details.description: Each detail matches at least one error the validator reports.

path.description: JSON Pointer to the failing value in the fixture.

code.description: The JSON Schema keyword that failed, as JSON Schema 2020-12's output format names it.

CaptureModelTest.description: Replays one HAR recording of model API traffic through the model proxy, with the stand-in provider in the provider's place, and compares the model call events it writes with an expected turn record.

name.description: Unique name of the test case.

description.description: The client, the API and what the recording verifies.

traffic.description: Path of the HAR 1.2 recording, relative to conformance/.

expect.description: Path of the expected turn record, relative to conformance/.

readInFull.description: Whether the stand-in is read as the providers' own hosts. Default true; false records every call raw, as a call to another host is.

CaptureToolTest.description: Runs one client scenario with the MCP SDK's own client, or plain HTTP requests, through the tool proxy to Spectra's own tool server, over each transport the case names, and compares the tool call events the proxy writes with the expected turn record of that transport.

name.description: Unique name of the test case.

description.description: What the scenario does and what its records verify.

scenario.description: The name of the client scenario the harness runs.

expect.description: The expected turn record of each transport the scenario runs over, relative to conformance/.

streamable_http.description: MCP over streamable HTTP, each reply a stream of server-sent events.

streamable_http_json.description: MCP over streamable HTTP, each reply JSON.

http.description: Plain HTTP requests to the server's routes.

ReplayModelTest.description: Runs one model capture case against its expected record instead of the provider: the model proxy armed with the record in everything-recorded mode, each recorded request sent through it, the replies compared with the recording and the calls it captures with the expected record, then one changed request that must miss.

name.description: Unique name of the test case.

description.description: What replay exercises in the recording.

traffic.description: Path of the capture case's HAR 1.2 recording, relative to conformance/.

expect.description: Path of the capture case's expected turn record, relative to conformance/, which the proxy is armed with.

readInFull.description: Whether the record's origin is read as the providers' own hosts. Default true; false reads every call raw, as the capture case does.

ReplayToolTest.description: Runs one tool capture scenario against its expected records instead of the tool server: the tool proxy armed with the record of each transport the case names and answering as the server, the calls it captures compared with the record, then one changed call that must miss.

name.description: Unique name of the test case.

description.description: What replay exercises in the scenario.

scenario.description: The name of the capture suite's client scenario the harness runs.

expect.description: The capture case's expected turn record of each transport, relative to conformance/, which the proxy is armed with.

streamable_http.description: MCP over streamable HTTP, each reply a stream of server-sent events.

streamable_http_json.description: MCP over streamable HTTP, each reply JSON.

http.description: Plain HTTP requests to the server's routes.

CaptureReceiverTest.description: Posts one live run's recorded OTLP/JSON export requests to the OTLP/HTTP receiver, with the turns of the expected record opened, their proxies' calls placed and each closed at its end, and compares the turns as written with the expected turn record.

name.description: Unique name of the test case.

description.description: The run, its producers and what the case verifies.

exports.description: Path of the recorded export requests, relative to conformance/: a JSON list of each request's path, its arrival time and its OTLP/JSON body.

expect.description: Path of the expected turn record, relative to conformance/: the turns the harness opens, each with its turn event, its proxies' calls and the receiver's events.

log.description: The lines the receiver prints, in order. None when it prints none.

CaptureWrapperTest.description: Runs one job through a driver per language that calls the pinned agent SDK with the A2UI wrapper switched on, inside a turn the harness opens, and compares the turn written with the expected turn record.

name.description: Unique name of the test case.

description.description: What the job does and what the case verifies.

job.description: Path of the driver's job, relative to conformance/.

expect.description: Path of the expected turn record, relative to conformance/: one path when the languages share it, else one per language.

python.description: The record the Python driver's turn must match.

typescript.description: The record the TypeScript driver's turn must match.

expected_to_fail.description: Per language, why the case fails at the pin, starting with the sub-task that owns it in the form "Sub-task N.M, at the pin:". The case still runs, as Node's test runner's todo.

WrapperCaptureJob.description: A driver's job: what it calls on the agent SDK, with the wrapper switched on. Paths of the text and the chunks are relative to the job's directory; a catalog's path is relative to conformance/.

languages.description: The languages the case runs in.

inferenceFormat.description: The inference format of the processor.

entryPoint.description: What the driver calls: the prompt generator, a whole-text parse, a stream, one block's compile, or the toolset's tool.

path.description: A custom catalog's catalog.json. Without it, the catalog is the basic catalog of its protocol version, built into the SDK.

examples.description: Path of the prompt's example turns, a JSON list of lists of A2UI messages, relative to the job's directory.

text.description: The case text: the whole text, the one block, the stream's text or the a2ui_payload.

chunks.description: A JSON list of each chunk's end in the text, in UTF-16 code units, for a stream.

wrapped.description: False when the whole text is one block without tags. True by default.

afterRejectedBlock.description: What a stream does after it rejects a block. end by default.

rendererState.description: For the toolset: whether a renderer state is bound to the processor. False by default.

beforeTurn.description: Whether the driver runs before the turn opens. False by default.
